name: vinyl-fs-utf8-transcoding-by-default-fontmin
behavioral_change: vinyl-fs v4.0.0 added an `encoding` option to `src()` and `dest()` with default 'utf8', so file contents are decoded and re-encoded through iconv-lite; v_old passed raw bytes through unchanged, and under v_new any byte sequence that is not valid utf8 is replaced with U+FFFD while `file.contents` remains a Buffer. The same release switched the stream implementation to streamx, so an error for an unmatched singular glob (unchanged text from glob-stream) now additionally raises an uncaught `TypeError: this.to.destroy is not a function` instead of being tolerated.
downstream_effect: The downstream font tool reads .ttf and .otf files through `vfs.src.apply(vfs, this.src())` in index.js; corrupted binaries fail every plugin's format sniff, so no ttf, eot, woff, svg or css output is produced, and the test hooks' `src(destPath)` calls on non-existent directories kill the whole suite. The delivered output shows only a "before all" hook failure with streamx-internal frames (or, in the harness path, 25 failures with frames only in tests and concat-stream, through2, duplexer and fonteditor-core), never naming vinyl-fs, glob-stream, encoding or allowEmpty.
reference_fix: The reference fix edits one hunk in `Fontmin.prototype.getFiles` in index.js, copying the saved options object and adding `encoding: false` and `allowEmpty: true` before forwarding it to `vfs.src`.
documented_in: The vinyl-fs CHANGELOG 4.0.0 section (https://github.com/gulpjs/vinyl-fs/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md) lists "Default to `utf8` decoding and encoding. Add `encoding` option to change (#287)" and "Switch stream implementation to streamx (#333)" under BREAKING CHANGES, and the vinyl-fs 4.0.2 README documents `options.encoding` (settable to `false`) as a parameter entry without a code example; `options.allowEmpty` is documented only as a parameter entry in the glob-stream 8.0.3 README, to which vinyl-fs forwards glob options, and the streamx crash is not announced as a change anywhere.
